comment: The declared keg layout of each Linkuistics skill formula, for scripts/shared-directory-seam.sh. 'layout' is that of the formula that the seam tests: Grove's template, or the formula file of a tap working copy. 'published' is that of the formula on the tap's published main, or null when that formula has no keg source. 'direct' means real source directories under share/ravel/skills. 'projected' means private sources in libexec/skill-sources with relative aliases under share/ravel/skills. 'The keg layout' of docs/specs/codex-skill-provisioning.md owns the layout. The seam refuses a keg that differs from its declaration, so change a declaration with the formula that it describes.
